name: nopCommerce Admin Analytics Benchmark
scope: Tier A formal report pages plus Tier B dashboard widgets from nopCommerce Admin.
notes: These SQL oracles are extracted from nopCommerce Admin source. They are reference result queries, not strings AEGIS is expected to reproduce exactly.
Each task pairs one nopCommerce Admin analytics surface with a natural-language request a store owner might ask.

Failure causes should distinguish architecture expressibility from implementation fidelity. A mismatch caused by a missing or wrong semantic-layer metric is an implementation fidelity gap, not by itself an architecture limitation.

tasks.name: Sales summary by month
tasks.prompt: Show me the monthly sales summary
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m') AS label, SUM(o.OrderTotal) AS value
FROM `order` o
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY label
LIMIT 100

tasks.name: Bestsellers by amount
tasks.prompt: Which products brought in the most revenue?
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT p.Name AS label, SUM(oi.PriceExclTax) AS value
FROM orderitem oi
JOIN `order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
JOIN product p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
JOIN address a ON o.BillingAddressId = a.Id
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND p.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY oi.ProductId, p.Name
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

tasks.name: Products never purchased
tasks.prompt: Which products have never been ordered?
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT p.Name AS label
FROM product p
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.ProductId
  FROM orderitem oi
  JOIN `order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
  WHERE o.Deleted = 0
) sold ON sold.ProductId = p.Id
WHERE sold.ProductId IS NULL
  AND p.ProductTypeId = 5
  AND p.Deleted = 0
ORDER BY p.Name
LIMIT 100

tasks.name: Country sales
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT co.Name AS label, SUM(o.OrderTotal) AS value
FROM `order` o
JOIN address a ON o.BillingAddressId = a.Id
JOIN country co ON a.CountryId = co.Id
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY a.CountryId, co.Name
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

tasks.name: Best customers by order total
tasks.prompt: Who are our top customers by amount spent?
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT c.Email AS label, SUM(o.OrderTotal) AS value
FROM customer c
JOIN `order` o ON c.Id = o.CustomerId
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND c.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.Id, c.Email
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

tasks.name: Best customers by order count
tasks.prompt: Which customers placed the most orders?
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT c.Email AS label, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM customer c
JOIN `order` o ON c.Id = o.CustomerId
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND c.Deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.Id, c.Email
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 100

tasks.name: Registered customers this month
tasks.prompt: How many customers registered this month?
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_customerrole_mapping ccrm ON c.Id = ccrm.Customer_Id
JOIN customerrole cr ON ccrm.CustomerRole_Id = cr.Id
WHERE c.Deleted = 0
  AND cr.SystemName = 'Registered'
  AND c.CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '%Y-%m-01')

tasks.name: Low stock products
tasks.prompt: Which products are low on stock?
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT p.Name AS label, CASE WHEN p.UseMultipleWarehouses THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pwi.StockQuantity - pwi.ReservedQuantity) FROM productwarehouseinventory pwi WHERE pwi.ProductId = p.Id), 0) ELSE p.StockQuantity END AS value
FROM product p
WHERE p.ManageInventoryMethodId = 1
  AND (CASE WHEN p.UseMultipleWarehouses THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pwi.StockQuantity - pwi.ReservedQuantity) FROM productwarehouseinventory pwi WHERE pwi.ProductId = p.Id), 0) ELSE p.StockQuantity END) <= p.MinStockQuantity
  AND p.Deleted = 0
  AND p.ProductTypeId <> 10
ORDER BY p.MinStockQuantity, p.DisplayOrder, p.Id
LIMIT 100

tasks.name: Dashboard bestsellers by amount
tasks.prompt: Show the dashboard bestsellers by amount
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT p.Name AS label, SUM(oi.PriceExclTax) AS value
FROM orderitem oi
JOIN `order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
JOIN product p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
JOIN address a ON o.BillingAddressId = a.Id
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND p.Deleted = 0

tasks.name: Dashboard bestsellers by quantity

FROM orderitem oi
JOIN `order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
JOIN product p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id

tasks.name: Dashboard latest orders
tasks.prompt: Show me the five latest orders
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT o.CustomOrderNumber AS label, o.OrderTotal AS value
FROM `order` o
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
ORDER BY o.CreatedOnUtc DESC, o.Id DESC
LIMIT 5

tasks.name: Dashboard incomplete orders
tasks.prompt: Show the dashboard incomplete order report
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT 'Total unpaid orders' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM `order` o
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND o.OrderStatusId <> 40
  AND o.PaymentStatusId = 10
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Total not shipped orders' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM `order` o
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND o.OrderStatusId <> 40
  AND o.ShippingStatusId = 20
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Total not delivered orders' AS label, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM `order` o
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND o.OrderStatusId <> 40
  AND o.ShippingStatusId <> 40

tasks.name: Dashboard order average report
tasks.prompt: Show the dashboard order average report by status
tasks.reference_sql:
SELECT status_label AS label,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CreatedOnUtc >= CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE) THEN OrderTotal ELSE 0 END) AS today,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CreatedOnUtc >= CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE) - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE)) DAY THEN OrderTotal ELSE 0 END) AS week,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN OrderTotal ELSE 0 END) AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '%Y-01-01') THEN OrderTotal ELSE 0 END) AS year,
  SUM(OrderTotal) AS all_time
FROM (
  SELECT CASE o.OrderStatusId WHEN 10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN 20 THEN 'Processing' WHEN 30 THEN 'Complete' WHEN 40 THEN 'Cancelled' ELSE CAST(o.OrderStatusId AS CHAR) END AS status_label,
         o.CreatedOnUtc,
         o.OrderTotal
  FROM `order` o
  WHERE o.Deleted = 0
) x
GROUP BY status_label
ORDER BY FIELD(status_label, 'Pending', 'Processing', 'Complete', 'Cancelled')

tasks.name: Dashboard order statistics
tasks.prompt: Show order counts for the last seven days
tasks.reference_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE days AS (
  SELECT CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE) - INTERVAL 7 DAY AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM days WHERE d < CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE)
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(days.d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(o.Id) AS value
FROM days
LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.CreatedOnUtc >= days.d AND o.CreatedOnUtc < days.d + INTERVAL 1 DAY
GROUP BY days.d
ORDER BY days.d

tasks.name: Dashboard customer statistics
tasks.prompt: Show customer registrations for the last seven days
tasks.reference_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE days AS (
  SELECT CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE) - INTERVAL 7 DAY AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM days WHERE d < CAST(UTC_TIMESTAMP() AS DATE)
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(days.d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(c.Id) AS value
FROM days
LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.CreatedOnUtc >= days.d AND c.CreatedOnUtc < days.d + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND c.Deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN customer_customerrole_mapping ccrm ON c.Id = ccrm.Customer_Id
LEFT JOIN customerrole cr ON ccrm.CustomerRole_Id = cr.Id AND cr.SystemName = 'Registered'
GROUP BY days.d
ORDER BY days.d

tasks.name: Dashboard popular search terms
tasks.prompt: Show the popular search terms report
